newsitem.title: USA: California officials to tour Asia for investments.
newsitem.headline: California officials to tour Asia for investments.

text.p: California's Treasurer and representatives from public pension funds with combined assets of $234 billion will begin an eight-day Asia investments tour on Monday, state officials said on Wednesday.

The purpose of the visit will be to identify investment opportunities for California pension funds and introduce California pension fund officials to Asian venture capitalists looking for opportunities in California, they said.
"This is an important trip for employees and investors in California's public and private retirement systems and for California businesses," state Treasurer Matt Fong said.

Fong's delegation will include officials with the California Public Employee Retirement System, the State Teachers Retirement System, the Los Angeles City Employees Retirement System, the Los Angeles Fire and Police Pension System, the San Diego County Employees Retirement Association, and Connecticut's Combined Investment Fund.

Robert Greber, chairman and chief executive officer of the Pacific Stock Exchange, will also accompany the delegation as they visit Hong Kong, China, Singapore and Taiwan from January 12 to January 19.
Fong said he would host a financial summit on January 13 in Hong Kong.
